description: Add inline JavaScript to HTML template that toggles displayed text between hey and what on click. Use simple click event listener. Files: plan-test-project/src/plan_test_project/web.py
acceptance_criteria: Clicking hey changes it to what; Clicking what changes it back to hey; All tests pass

acceptance_criteria: Single command starts the web server; Server runs on localhost:5000; Browser can access and interact with the page
